messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The process of Vacations Request starts when any employee of the organization submits a vacation request. Once the requirement is registered, the request is received by the immediate supervisor of the employee requesting the vacation. The supervisor must approve or reject the request. If the request is rejected, the application is returned to the applicant / employee who can review the rejection reasons. If the request is approved a notification is generated to the Human Resources Representative, who must complete the respective management procedures.

    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_VacationProcess">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RequestSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewRejectionReasons</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RequestRejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ApprovalDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="Human Resources Representative">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteManagementProcedures</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RequestApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="Vacation Request Submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToSupervisor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows from Start -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSupervisor" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest" />

    <!-- Supervisor Tasks & Gateway -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest" name="Approve or Reject Vacation Request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToSupervisor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SupervisorToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SupervisorToGateway" sourceRef="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" name="Request Approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SupervisorToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Rejection Branch -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="No (Rejected)" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" />

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" name="Review Rejection Reasons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToRejectionEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToRejectionEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestRejected" name="Vacation Request Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToRejectionEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Approval Branch -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Yes (Approved)" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Task_NotifyHR" />

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyHR" name="Notify HR Representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyToHRProcedures</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToHRProcedures" sourceRef="Task_NotifyHR" targetRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" />

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" name="Complete Management Procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyToHRProcedures</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HRProceduresToApprovalEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HRProceduresToApprovalEnd" sourceRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestApproved" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestApproved" name="Vacation Request Processed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HRProceduresToApprovalEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
